# Hash-pinned dependencies for CI, covering everything in requirements.txt and
# tests/requirements.txt that comes from PyPI, plus their transitive dependencies, plus
# the build backend so that --no-build-isolation resolves to a pinned setuptools rather
# than whatever the runner image happens to carry.
#
# pip applies --require-hashes to every requirement in a command, and a git SHA pin
# cannot carry a hash, so embit and pyzbar are installed in a separate command. Both
# are pinned to immutable commit SHAs and declare no runtime dependencies, so they
# install with --no-deps and nothing floats.
#
# Regenerate after changing either source file:
#   uv pip compile --generate-hashes --python-version 3.10 \
#       -o tests/requirements-ci.txt - <<'DEPS'
#   <the non-git lines of requirements.txt and tests/requirements.txt, plus
#    setuptools and wheel at the versions below>
#   DEPS
